description: Somos un equipo que desarrollaremos un simulador para un astronauta junior basado en las estadísticas proporcionadas par su uso correspondiente como un juego establecido para proporcionar enseñanza a los jugadores en experiencia de una misión espacial
summary:
Missions in mars is an game and technological project designed to introduce students to the fascinating world of space exploration through an interactive experience inspired by real NASA missions.
The project consists of a space simulator in which players take on the role of astronauts with the mission of exploring the planet Mars, discovering its characteristics, investigating its surface, and learning what it would be like to live and work in an extraterrestrial environment.
Through the "Explore Mars" section, players can control their astronaut, move through different environments, observe their surroundings, discover elements of the planet, and complete exploration activities. In this way, learning goes beyond theory and becomes a dynamic experience in which every discovery provides new knowledge.
The project combines astronomy, science, technology, and programming, developing curiosity, scientific thinking, problem-solving, and creativity.
Main Objective
 experience that helps students understand the conditions on Mars and the challenges of space exploration through an astronaut mission simulation.
Purpose
To demonstrate that technology and video games can be effective learning tools, interested in science, and space research.
details:
OBJECTIVE: survive three memory emergencies and a free expedition across Mars without any resource reaching 0.

Players take the role of aerospace engineers, designing spacecraft, selecting equipment, managing energy, mass and budgets, and solving unexpected mission challenges.

The simulator introduces real STEM concepts through interactive missions to Earth orbit, the Moon, and Mars. Each decision has consequences, helping students understand the engineering challenges behind space exploration.

ASTRO MISSION JUNIOR focuses on realistic engineering decisions rather than just space exploration. Its goal is to make aerospace engineering accessible, engaging, and educational for young learners.

Technology: Claude AI was used to assist in designing and developing the interactive prototype. The implementation uses the technologies supported by the selected development environment.
